dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Have a question for me, cutie?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: All you need to do is add the ingredients into the cauldron, follow the steps provided, and you're good to go.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Using different herbs in the brewing process will, in turn, alter the effects of the potion. There's a whole bunch of combinations to try.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Bio-alchemical processing can infuse herbs with different effects and properties. The type of potion you want to brew will determine what kinds of herbs you need to cultivate.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: You'll need to consult the news of the market to determine what kinds of potions to brew.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I already took the liberty of compiling the latest details on the market for you. You can find the information I collected right by those shelves over there.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, if there's anything else you want to ask, don't hesitate to come and find me.
